messages:
zoe_cs: Heads-up thread for Sentinel Health onboarding. They requested a private 6B clinical summarizer with per-record PHI redaction, HSM key control, EU residency, and a short safety pass before signing Dedicated. Also asked about burst capacity for end-of-month batch jobs.
rafael_se: Quick compat check: model loads, int4 quant looks OK. Kept fp16 KV cache to retain clinical accuracy. Artifacts staged at s3://private-artifacts/sentinel/6b/v1.
dr_mendes_sentinel: Confirming: we need client-managed HSM + no token retention. Also want a reproducible eval they can run in their CI, plus guidance for tokenization so notes map to patient IDs consistently.
kyra_ml: Draft eval plan: 1) PHI redaction stress (n=1k) 2) clinical hallucination probes (n=500) 3) instruction-fidelity tests with their templates (n=300). Pass targets: redaction >= 99.8%, hallucination rate < 0.3%.
theo_security: Security: HSM connector requires their infra to accept a connector VM in their VPC. We can disable token logging and redact prompt/response text from telemetry. We'll produce a minimal checklist and network diagram.
zoe_cs: Renewal note: they tied year-1 committed capacity to pilot SLA. If sustained throughput < 70% of agreed baseline or PHI redaction fails, they may reduce commitment. Flagging renewal-risk-high and escalating to AE.
dr_mendes_sentinel: Also need runbook entries for failover to hosted EU variant with tenant-level audit events only (no token payloads). Legal insists on explicit fallback steps.
rafael_se: We'll add an automated fallback policy to tenant config. Example tenant policy we plan to use:
```
{"tenant":"sentinel","deploy_mode":"private","region":"eu-west-1","hsm":true,"no_token_logging":true,"fallback":"hosted-eu-6b","burst_capacity":{"enabled":true,"max_gpu":4}}
```
kyra_ml: Eval runner (single-command) for their CI:
```
./sentinel_eval --endpoint https://private.redwood/sentinel-6b --suite sentinel_phi_suite.json --seed 123 --out report.json
```
This runs deterministically for the suite.
theo_security: Action: I'll post the HSM connector checklist and the required subnet/CIDR ranges by EOD tomorrow. Need Sentinel infra sign-off.
kyra_ml: Action: I'll run the initial PHI/redaction probes and post results + sample prompts within 48 hours.
zoe_cs: I'll schedule a 60-min enablement + runbook walkthrough the week before pilot start. Pilot target: 2026-05-10.
dr_mendes_sentinel: Week of May 3rd for enablement works. Also request: a short summary doc we can attach to our compliance audit.
rafael_se: We'll assemble a short compliance summary + the runbook snippets for failover, keys, and telemetry.
deploy-bot: private staging deploy for sentinel-6b started at 2026-03-22T17:04:11Z  logs: https://deploys.redwood/staging/1762123456
zoe_cs: Thanks everyone  keeping this thread as the canonical onboarding tracker, safety/eval artifacts, and renewal-risk note.
